description: Pass exactly ONE of intent_id, order_number, order_id or track_url (two or none is refused). Use intent_id right after execute_purchase, order_number or track_url for a guest order. Any guest can check coarse status using their order_number. A full track_url from checkout unlocks guest details across sessions; never invent or fetch a tracking URL. An account or internal connection can use its own order_number or order_id. intent_id remains supported. Order creation is not delivery success.
name: purchase_status
title: Status pesanan
